title: The last thing creators add, the first thing viewers notice: Why Adobe is introducing music, speech, and sound effect generation to Firefly
key_facts: Adobe has added audio tools to Firefly: music, voiceovers and sound effects, all described by Adobe as 'commercially safe' in an official blog post.
Firefly now covers images, video and audio, with models from Adobe, Google, OpenAI, Runway, Kling AI, Luma AI and others.
Adobe's Meg Donovan says the Generate Music feature is available to all users and gives original, licensed music tailored to a piece of content.
Two creators quoted say licensed, safe-to-use music saves them hours of searching and licensing worries.
Adobe is also giving free access to Firefly AI Assistant, a text-prompt agent that walks users through projects; the free version allows a limited number of daily generations.
A subscription with 2,000+ generative credits a month starts at $9.99 a month.
quote_evidence: A new suite of audio tools gives users access to music, voiceovers, and sound effects–all of which are “commercially safe,” Adobe said in an official blog post.
The free version of Firefly AI Assistant allows a limited amount of daily generations.
Upgrading to a subscription with 2,000+ generative credits per month starts at $9.99/mo.
why_it_matters_hint: Creators who need licensed music for videos get a built-in generator, according to Adobe and creators using it.
event_date: Not stated; article dated 2 Oct 2026. Launch date of the audio tools is not given.
